title: Libelant
summary: LI'BELANT, noun One who libels; one who brings a libel or institutes a suit in an admiralty court. The counsel for the libelant contended they had a right to read the instructions.

inlines.v: LI'BELANT, noun One who libels; one who brings a libel or institutes a suit in an admiralty court. The counsel for the libelant contended they had a right to read the instructions.
